name: claims
title: WWII unit location claims
description: One row per claim. Same header in every file under data/claims/. Vocabulary-backed fields refer to keys in schema/vocabularies.json.

fields.name: claim_id
fields.description: Unique id of the claim, C0001 onward. One row is one claim ("this unit was here on this date"). Never reused.

fields.name: conflict_group_id
fields.description: Shared by rows that make competing claims about the same unit and event (G001...). Blank if no known conflict.

fields.name: claim_status
fields.description: preferred, alternate or disputed (see vocabulary).

fields.name: unit_id
fields.description: Stable unit key, NATION-TYPE-NUMBER+ECHELONLETTER (for example US-INF-029D). Must exist in data/units.csv and match the file name.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date of the claim, YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: theater
fields.description: Primary theater of the claim (see vocabulary).

fields.name: nationality
fields.description: Nationality of the unit: US, UK, Canada, Germany (extend as needed). Matches the data/claims/<nationality>/ folder in lowercase.

fields.name: unit_name
fields.description: Unit name only, for example "29th Infantry Division".

fields.name: echelon
fields.description: Organisational level (see vocabulary).

fields.name: branch
fields.description: Service or arm (see vocabulary).

fields.name: parent_formation
fields.description: Formation the unit was subordinate or attached to on that date, "Name (unit_id)" when the parent is in units.csv; several parents are separated by "; " ("; attached to ..." marks an attachment). "unknown" if not verified.

fields.name: commander
fields.description: Commander on that date, rank and name as given by sources; "unknown" if not verified.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Decimal degrees WGS84.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Decimal degrees WGS84.

fields.name: location_name
fields.description: Name of the place the coordinate refers to.

fields.name: location_represents
fields.description: What the point stands for (see vocabulary).

fields.name: precision_km
fields.description: Judgment estimate of the radius in km within which the unit probably was (banded).

fields.name: operation_name
fields.description: Parent operation, for example Overlord.

fields.name: sub_operation_name
fields.description: Sub-operation(s), semicolon-separated (Neptune, Epsom, Perch, ...). Blank for plain parent-operation rows.

fields.name: composing_units
fields.description: Subordinate units, listed when first given or when they change; blank means unchanged from the unit's previous row; "unknown" means no data.

fields.name: established
fields.description: True on the row where the source says the unit was formed.

fields.name: disestablished
fields.description: True on the row where the source says the unit was disbanded.

fields.name: destroyed
fields.description: True on the row where the source says the unit was destroyed.

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: Numeric 0-1 confidence by rubric (see vocabulary).

fields.name: source
fields.description: URLs separated by " | " ending with the coordinate source note. Every row needs at least one URL.

fields.name: event_type
fields.description: One primary event type (see vocabulary).

fields.name: current_activity
fields.description: Short phrase saying what the unit is doing on that date at that place; lower-case, free text.

fields.name: engaged_with
fields.description: Enemy units fought on that date, nationality first, separated by "; ". Blank = no combat that day; "unknown" = combat with no opponent identified.

fields.name: strength_status
fields.description: Qualitative strength (see vocabulary).

fields.name: strength_json
fields.description: Optional JSON object with sourced strength figures: {"basis","as_of","personnel","vehicles","vehicle_count_type","source","note"}. See docs/methodology.md. Blank where no source gives figures.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Free text: what the source says, caveats, source conflicts, change history.
